subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “During a home repair, Sam found old newspapers under the floor.”?
options: It sits near the door and plays songs from many years ago.
Workers cleaning a storage room found old election posters from many years ago.
Eric looked at a map from one hundred years ago.
They were used many years ago to protect the wood.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「It sits near the door and plays songs from many years ago.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Workers cleaning a storage room found old election posters from many years ago.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Eric looked at a map from one hundred years ago.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「They were used many years ago to protect the wood.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「They were used many years ago to protect the wood.」，答案為「They were used many years ago to protect the wood.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「They were used many years ago to protect the wood.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
